wish: someone should make a simple entertaining guide that teaches Americans the metric system
spec:
Eleven quick questions that ask you to pick the right metric size for an everyday thing: a door, a soda can, a hot day, a mile.
Tap an answer; it shows right or wrong plus one thing to remember it by, then Next.
It does not convert arbitrary numbers or teach the full system; the score and best run are saved on the device.
